quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 revenue a record US$717.5 million, up 26.8% YoY and 8.6% QoQ, on higher wafer shipments and ASPs; gross margin 16.5% (+5.6 points YoY, +3.5 points QoQ), both better than guidance; profit attributable to owners US$38.6 million (+385.9% YoY). By platform: embedded NVM US$200.1 million (+41.8%, MCU and smart card), standalone NVM US$68.8 million (+149.3%, flash), power discrete US$182.3 million (+9.4%, general MOSFET), analog and power management US$183.1 million (+13.0%), logic and RF US$83.2 million (+21.3%). 12-inch wafer revenue US$445.7 million (62.1%); North America revenue +77.0% YoY; computing end-market revenue +48.1%.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hua Hong Semiconductor results press release: Second Quarter 2026 Results (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and President Dr. Bai Peng: since the start of the year AI has driven global semiconductor demand growth, first visible in memory chips and gradually extending to AI-related logic and analog chips; as a specialty foundry serving broad end markets Hua Hong has clearly benefited from the AI wave, though demand strength and durability still differ across end segments. The company kept high utilization, all technology platforms grew (standalone and embedded NVM especially), and volume and price both rose. It will keep expanding capacity steadily, upgrading specialty processes and optimizing capacity allocation and product mix; it has received CSRC registration approval for the Huali Micro acquisition, which it says will strengthen its technology portfolio, scale and profitability.
